d.a: Distribution and habits. Boulenophrys youran sp. nov. is currently known from Chengbu Miao Autonomous County and Xinning County, Hunan Province, China (1 040 – 1 750 m a. s. l.). The new species inhabits flowing montane streams and nearby forest floors within subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forest. It was frequently encountered near streams (Fig. 11), in sympatry with B. shunhuangensis. Females with mature eggs and calling males were found from April to June. Notably, nuptial pads of males collected in September without distinct nuptial spines, suggesting a period of reproductive inactivity during that time.
